description: This file defines the LogWrapper class which implements the LogNode interface. The class wraps Android's native logging utility Log, allowing log data to be forwarded to subsequent nodes in a chain. It manages log message formatting, especially handling null messages and exceptions, and facilitates multi-target logging pipelines.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that implements logging functionality by wrapping Android's native Log utility, and forwarding logs to the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain to receive log data.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Outputs log messages using Android's Log mechanism; handles message formatting, exceptions, and propagates the log to the next node.
